name: Bad Saber
summary:
Bad Saber is a thrilling VR arcade game where your mission is simple: use your badminton skills to destroy oncoming adversaries!  
Armed with your saber, swing with precision and power through 8 action-packed levels—each featuring unique backgrounds, target types, and increasingly intense gameplay.

Unleash drive shots, powerful smashes, and precision hits as you react quickly to birdies that spawn and move dynamically based on the level. As you progress, the challenge ramps up with faster game speed, trick
